items.title: Effects of chair-based exercise training on pulmonary function, exercise capacity, and quality of life in patients with acute exacerbation of COPD: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial of 30 AECOPD patients found chair-based exercise training significantly improved functional exercise capacity (6MWT distance: mean change 79.7m vs 28.8m, p=0.042), dyspnoea, and quality of life compared to breathing exercises alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了在COPD急性加重住院期间开展椅旁运动训练的强有力证据。它坐实了该干预不仅可行，而且能显著改善患者的功能运动能力、呼吸困难和生活质量，应当被纳入你的临床常规。
items.titleZh: 椅旁运动训练对COPD急性加重患者肺功能、运动能力和生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入30名COPD急性加重患者的随机对照试验发现，与单纯呼吸练习相比，椅旁运动训练显著改善了功能运动能力（6分钟步行距离平均变化79.7米 vs 28.8米，p=0.042）、呼吸困难和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides strong evidence for implementing chair-based exercise training during hospitalization for acute COPD exacerbations. It confirms that this intervention is not only feasible but also significantly improves patients' functional exercise capacity, dyspnea, and quality of life, and should be incorporated into your clinical routine.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且仅在单一医院环境中进行，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size and was conducted in a single hospital setting, which may limit the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Effects of Functional Inspiratory Muscle Training in Individuals with Obesity: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial investigated the effects of functional inspiratory muscle training in individuals with obesity, a chronic disease impacting cardiometabolic, respiratory, and musculoskeletal systems.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明功能性吸气肌训练可能对肥胖个体有益，尤其考虑到肥胖对心肺和肌肉骨骼系统的多方面影响。这提示你可以在综合康复策略中考虑吸气肌训练，以改善呼吸功能和运动耐力。
items.titleZh: 功能性吸气肌训练对肥胖个体的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验研究了功能性吸气肌训练对肥胖个体的影响。肥胖是一种影响心肺和肌肉骨骼系统的慢性疾病。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial suggests that functional inspiratory muscle training may benefit individuals with obesity, especially given the multifactorial impact of obesity on cardiorespiratory and musculoskeletal systems. This indicates you could consider inspiratory muscle training within comprehensive rehabilitation strategies to improve respiratory function and exercise tolerance.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供详细的研究结果，无法评估干预的具体效应量和临床意义。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide detailed study results, preventing evaluation of the specific effect sizes and clinical significance of the intervention.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Efficacy of real-time feedback exercise therapy in patients following total hip arthroplasty: a pilot cluster-randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot cluster-randomized controlled trial with 22 patients found no statistically significant differences in functional outcomes between real-time feedback-assisted home-exercise and standard written instructions following total hip arthroplasty, although the feedback group reported greater motivation.
items.curatedReason: 本试验表明，全髋关节置换术后，实时反馈的居家锻炼与传统书面指导在改善功能和生活质量上无显著差异。提示技术辅助可能更多影响患者体验而非直接功能提升，在评估此类技术时要综合考量。
items.titleZh: 实时反馈运动疗法对全髋关节置换术患者的疗效：一项试点集群随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入22名患者的试点集群随机对照试验发现，全髋关节置换术后，实时反馈辅助居家锻炼与标准书面指导在改善功能结局方面无统计学差异，但反馈组患者报告了更高的锻炼动力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This trial shows no significant difference between real-time feedback home exercise and standard written instructions in improving function and quality of life after total hip arthroplasty. It suggests technology assistance may impact patient experience more than direct functional improvement, necessitating comprehensive consideration when evaluating such technologies.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本试点研究，参与者年龄范围窄，且未能充分评估患者报告的依从性与实际训练量之间的关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a small pilot study with a narrow age range, and it did not adequately assess the relationship between patient-reported adherence and actual training volume.

items.title: e-health in musculoskeletal primary care physiotherapy: Evidence, facilitators, and barriers - A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 45 studies mapped e-Health solutions in primary care musculoskeletal physiotherapy, identifying internet-based solutions, mobile apps, and video consultations as most common, alongside 21 facilitators and 23 barriers to implementation.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述描绘了基层物理治疗中数字健康的现状，指出了其潜力与尚存障碍。它确认了虚拟现实、可穿戴设备等新兴技术的证据空白，指导你未来的技术采纳和培训策略。
items.titleZh: 肌肉骨骼初级物理治疗中的电子健康：证据、促进因素和障碍——一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入45项研究的范围综述，梳理了初级肌肉骨骼物理治疗中的电子健康解决方案，发现互联网方案、移动应用和视频咨询最为常见，并识别出21个促进因素和23个障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review maps the current landscape of e-Health in primary care physiotherapy, highlighting its potential and persistent barriers. It identifies evidence gaps in emerging technologies like virtual reality and wearables, guiding your future technology adoption and training strategies.
items.limitation: 研究方法和数字健康干预的异质性、高收入国家研究的主导地位以及技术快速发展限制了结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in study methods and e-Health modalities, the predominance of studies from high-income countries, and rapid technological advancements limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: What's In The Box? Previewing the APTA Private Practice Annual Conference 2026
items.summary: An article previewing the APTA Private Practice Annual Conference 2026, scheduled for November 4, 2026, offering insights into upcoming trends and discussions relevant to private practice.
items.curatedReason: 这次APTA私人执业年会预告是个前瞻性的消息。提前关注这类会议议程，你能大概知道2026年PT行业可能聚焦哪些商业模式、技术创新或政策调整，为你的诊所及早布局、抓住机遇。
items.titleZh: 2026年11月4日 “盒中乾坤”：APTA私人执业年会2026预告
items.summaryZh: 一篇文章预告了将于2026年11月4日举行的APTA私人执业年会，提供了有关私人执业相关的新趋势和讨论的见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preview for the APTA Private Practice Annual Conference is a heads-up. Keeping an eye on these agendas early lets you anticipate which business models, technological innovations, or policy shifts will be top of mind for PTs in 2026, giving you a chance to strategically position your clinic and seize opportunities.

items.title: Validation and prognostic value of the five-repetition sit-to-stand test in patients with severe exacerbation of COPD.
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=58) found the 5-repetition sit-to-stand (5STS) test correlated with quadriceps force (r = -0.487) and 6-minute walk test (r = -0.415) in severe ECOPD patients. A cut-off of ≥13 seconds predicted higher readmission risk within six months (AUC = 0.720; 95% CI: 0.588-0.853).
items.curatedReason: 五次坐站试验（5STS）在重度慢性阻塞性肺疾病（ECOPD）患者中得到了验证，它与肌肉力量和运动耐量相关，并能预测六个月内的再入院风险。你可以将 5STS ≥ 13 秒作为识别高风险再入院患者的简单工具。
items.titleZh: 五次坐站试验在慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重期患者中的验证和预后价值
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察研究（n=58）发现，五次坐站试验（5STS）与重度慢性阻塞性肺疾病（ECOPD）患者的股四头肌力量（r = -0.487）和 6 分钟步行试验（r = -0.415）相关。5STS  ≥ 13 秒的截点能预测六个月内较高的再入院风险（AUC = 0.720；95% CI: 0.588-0.853）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The five-repetition sit-to-stand (5STS) test has been validated in severe exacerbation of COPD (ECOPD) patients, correlating with muscle strength and exercise tolerance, and predicting readmission risk within six months. You can use 5STS ≥ 13 seconds as a simple tool to identify patients at higher risk of readmission.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告多中心、随访时间或其他限制。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report on multicenter design, follow-up duration, or other limitations.

items.title: Predicting Robot-Based Tracking Performance After Stroke Using Lesion Features and Clinical Assessments: A Pilot Study
items.summary: A pilot study in chronic stroke patients found that clinical assessments significantly predicted robot-based tracking error (R²=0.45) and other kinematic outcomes, outperforming lesion features. The Box and Blocks Test and Color Trails 1 were stable predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，在慢性卒中患者的机器人辅助追踪任务表现预测中，临床评估（特别是注意力和运动相关指标）优于病灶特征。你在评估患者康复潜力时，应优先考虑结合认知运动功能的临床测试。
items.titleZh: 利用病灶特征和临床评估预测卒中后机器人辅助追踪表现：一项试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对慢性卒中患者的试点研究发现，临床评估能显著预测机器人辅助追踪误差（R²=0.45）及其他运动学结果，优于病灶特征。Box and Blocks 测试和 Color Trails 1 是稳定的预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that clinical assessments, especially attention and motor-related measures, outperform lesion features in predicting robot-based tracking performance after chronic stroke. You should prioritize clinical tests that incorporate cognitive-motor function when assessing patient rehabilitation potential.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的试点研究，可能限制其结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study with a small sample size, which may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Efficacy of whole-body vibration training in the management of patients with COPD: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 15 RCTs found whole-body vibration training significantly improved 6-minute walk distance (MD = 34.35 m; 95% CI: 13.67, 55.04) and 5-repetition sit-to-stand (MD = -5.95 seconds; 95% CI: -10.76, -1.14) in COPD patients compared to usual care, but not when compared to active exercise interventions.
items.curatedReason: 该系统综述提示全身振动训练（WBVT）在改善慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者功能容量方面，仅在与无康复干预（常规护理）比较时有临床意义的改善。你应继续推荐传统的运动康复，而非将 WBVT 视为其替代方案。
items.titleZh: 全身振动训练在慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者管理中的疗效：一项系统综述和Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 15 项 RCT 的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，全身振动训练在慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者中，与常规护理相比，显著改善了 6 分钟步行距离（MD = 34.35 m；95% CI: 13.67, 55.04）和 5 次坐站试验（MD = -5.95 秒；95% CI: -10.76, -1.14），但在与主动运动干预比较时无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review suggests whole-body vibration training (WBVT) offers clinically meaningful improvements in functional capacity for COPD patients only when compared to usual care (no rehabilitation). You should continue recommending traditional exercise rehabilitation, not WBVT as a substitute.
items.limitation: 大多数试验存在高偏倚风险，证据确定性为低至极低。
items.limitationEn: Most trials presented a high risk of bias, and evidence certainty ranged from low to very low.

items.title: Dizziness, Lower Limb Weakness, and Falls in COPD: A Prospective Longitudinal Pilot Study Using Monthly Home Diaries.
items.summary: A prospective longitudinal pilot study (n=27) found that monthly home diary monitoring of symptoms like dizziness (AUC = 0.813; optimism-corrected 0.81; p = 0.002) and lower limb weakness (AUC = 0.739; p = 0.034) showed higher discrimination for falls in COPD patients than single-visit baseline assessments.
items.curatedReason: 对于 COPD 患者，居家症状日记或许是比单次门诊评估更好的跌倒风险预测工具，尤其是对头晕 (AUC = 0.813) 和下肢无力 (AUC = 0.739) 的记录。尽管这是个小样本初步研究，提示我们跌倒风险的评估可能需要更动态和持续的方法。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者的眩晕、下肢无力和跌倒：一项使用月度居家日记的前瞻性纵向试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性纵向试点研究（n=27）发现，通过月度居家日记监测眩晕（AUC = 0.813；校正后 0.81；p = 0.002）和下肢无力（AUC = 0.739；p = 0.034）等症状，在预测慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者跌倒方面显示出比单次基线评估更高的鉴别能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: For COPD patients, a home symptom diary might be a superior tool for predicting fall risk than single-visit assessments, particularly for dizziness (AUC = 0.813) and lower limb weakness (AUC = 0.739). While a small pilot study, it suggests that fall risk assessment may require a more dynamic and continuous approach.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本（n=27）的探索性前瞻性观察研究。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory prospective observational pilot study with a small sample size (n=27).
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effect of Incorporating Perceptual Learning Into Plantar Hardness Discrimination on the Risk of Falling and Muscle Torque in Patients With Hemiplegia: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=34 stroke patients) found that incorporating perceptual learning with plantar hardness discrimination into rehabilitation significantly lowered fall risk (P <0.001, ES=1.48), increased knee extensors torque (P <0.001, ES=1.19), and improved FIM scores (P <0.001, ES=1.56) in hemiplegic patients compared to controls.
items.curatedReason: 将足底硬度辨别知觉学习纳入偏瘫患者康复方案，能显著降低跌倒风险 (ES=1.48)、增强膝关节伸肌扭矩 (ES=1.19) 和提高功能独立性 (ES=1.56)。这提示知觉学习是神经康复的重要补充。
items.titleZh: 将知觉学习纳入足底硬度辨别对偏瘫患者跌倒风险和肌肉扭矩的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对34名偏瘫患者进行的随机对照试验显示，将足底硬度辨别知觉学习纳入康复计划，能显著降低跌倒风险 (P <0.001, ES=1.48)，增加膝伸肌扭矩 (P <0.001, ES=1.19)，并提高功能独立性 (P <0.001, ES=1.56)。
items.curatedReasonEn: Incorporating perceptual learning of plantar hardness discrimination into rehabilitation for hemiplegic patients significantly reduces fall risk (ES=1.48), enhances knee extensor torque (ES=1.19), and improves functional independence (ES=1.56). This suggests perceptual learning is a crucial addition to neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心小样本研究（34名患者），结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center study with a small sample size (34 patients), limiting the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of different physical therapies for axillary web syndrome after breast cancer surgery: A network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (1007 patients) found that soft tissue manual therapy + therapeutic exercise + low-level laser therapy significantly reduced pain (SMD = -4.40) and improved shoulder ROM, while manual lymphatic drainage + therapeutic exercise significantly improved upper-limb disability (MD = -19.01) in patients with axillary web syndrome after breast cancer surgery.
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析坐实了特定物理疗法组合对乳腺癌术后腋网综合征（AWS）的疗效。软组织手法 + 治疗性运动 + 低能量激光（LLLT）能有效缓解疼痛和改善肩关节活动度，而手法淋巴引流 + 治疗性运动则在改善上肢功能方面效果最佳。在处理 AWS 时，请优先考虑这些证据等级最高的组合。
items.titleZh: 不同物理疗法治疗乳腺癌术后腋网综合征的比较有效性：一项随机对照试验的网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含14项随机对照试验（1007名患者）的网络荟萃分析显示，在乳腺癌术后腋网综合征患者中，软组织手法 + 治疗性运动 + 低能量激光疗法能显著减轻疼痛（SMD = -4.40）并改善肩关节活动度，而手法淋巴引流 + 治疗性运动则显著改善上肢功能障碍（MD = -19.01）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis confirms the efficacy of specific physical therapy combinations for axillary web syndrome (AWS) after breast cancer surgery. Soft tissue manual therapy + therapeutic exercise + low-level laser therapy (LLLT) effectively reduces pain and improves shoulder range of motion, while manual lymphatic drainage + therapeutic exercise is best for improving upper limb function. Prioritize these high-evidence combinations when treating AWS.
items.limitation: 证据确定性受稀疏网络、临床异质性以及模型依赖结果（随机效应分析中多个CrI跨过零值）的限制。
items.limitationEn: Evidence certainty is limited by sparse network, clinical heterogeneity, and model-dependent results (several CrIs crossing null in random-effects analysis).

items.title: Effects of 12-week massage on pain, muscle co-contraction, and knee loading in medial knee osteoarthritis: a randomized clinical trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=56) found that 12 weeks of massage therapy significantly improved WOMAC pain, stiffness, and physical function, and reduced medial muscle co-contraction during early stance in individuals with medial knee osteoarthritis, compared to a healthcare education group.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT明确指出，为期12周的按摩疗法在改善内侧膝骨关节炎患者的疼痛、僵硬、身体功能以及减少早期站立期内侧肌肉共同收缩方面，优于健康教育。您可以考虑将按摩疗法作为膝骨关节炎患者症状管理和神经肌肉功能改善的有效辅助手段，但需注意其对膝关节负荷和步速没有显著影响。
items.titleZh: 12周按摩疗法对内侧膝骨关节炎患者疼痛、肌肉共同收缩和膝关节负荷的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=56）发现，与健康教育组相比，为期12周的按摩疗法能显著改善内侧膝骨关节炎患者的WOMAC疼痛、僵硬和身体功能，并减少早期站立期的内侧肌肉共同收缩。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT clearly indicates that 12 weeks of massage therapy is superior to health education in improving pain, stiffness, physical function, and reducing medial muscle co-contraction during early stance in patients with medial knee osteoarthritis. You can consider massage therapy as an effective adjunct for symptom management and neuromuscular function improvement in knee OA patients, but note it has no significant effect on knee loading or walking speed.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心研究，结果的外推性可能有限，且未探讨按摩的长期效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center study, so the generalizability of its findings may be limited, and the long-term effects of massage were not explored.

items.title: Walking Capacity and Daily Movement Behaviours After Ischemic Stroke: A Potential Capacity-Performance Gap.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study found that although subacute stroke patients had faster gait speed (0.89 vs 0.71 m/s) and shorter Timed Up and Go times than acute patients, both groups accumulated approximately 12 hours of sedentary time daily, suggesting a capacity-performance gap.
items.curatedReason: 尽管急性期和亚急性期卒中患者的步态速度和时间起立行走测试表现有所改善，但每日久坐时间仍高达12小时。这提示可能存在“能力-表现”差距，提醒您在康复中不仅要关注步行能力，还要积极干预日常活动行为，以促进真正的社区步行和功能独立。
items.titleZh: 缺血性卒中后步行能力与日常活动行为：潜在的能力-表现差距
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，尽管亚急性期卒中患者的步态速度更快（0.89 vs 0.71 m/s）且时间起立行走测试用时更短，但两组患者每天的久坐时间仍约为12小时，这提示可能存在能力-表现差距。
items.curatedReasonEn: Despite improved gait speed and TUG scores in acute and subacute stroke patients, daily sedentary time remained high at around 12 hours. This suggests a potential "capacity-performance gap," reminding you to focus not only on walking capacity but also actively intervene in daily movement behaviors to promote genuine community ambulation and functional independence.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality, and has a relatively small sample size.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Implementing low-cost Capability, Opportunity Motivation and Behaviour (COM-B) interventions to increase bed-substitution rehabilitation referrals in acute stroke care.
items.summary: An implementation study found that low-cost COM-B interventions (education, information sheets, patient stories, staff working across acute and bed-substitution, and referral process changes) increased referrals to bed-substitution rehabilitation from acute stroke and neurology wards from 5.6% to 9.6% (p=0.002).
items.curatedReason: 这项实施研究表明，通过干预策略（教育、信息单、患者故事、跨病房工作和流程改进）可以显著提高急性卒中患者转诊至床位替代康复服务的比例（从5.6%提高到9.6%，p = 0.002）。这为您在临床实践中优化转诊流程、促进早期康复提供了实证支持，您可以借鉴这些低成本干预措施。
items.titleZh: 在急性卒中护理中实施低成本能力、机会、动机和行为（COM-B）干预以增加床位替代康复转诊
items.summaryZh: 一项实施研究发现，低成本的COM-B干预措施（包括教育、信息单、患者故事、跨病房工作人员合作以及转诊流程变更）使急性卒中和神经科病房的床位替代康复转诊率从5.6%提高到9.6%（p=0.002）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This implementation study shows that intervention strategies (education, information sheets, patient stories, cross-ward work, and process improvements) can significantly increase referrals to bed-substitution rehabilitation services for acute stroke patients (from 5.6% to 9.6%, p = 0.002). This provides empirical support for optimizing referral processes and promoting early rehabilitation in your clinical practice, and you can draw lessons from these low-cost interventions.

items.title: Acute neuromuscular and postural control responses to balance exercise with blood flow restriction in sedentary adults: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A three-arm randomized controlled trial (n=74 healthy sedentary adults) found no significant acute additional benefits for postural control, proprioception, functional performance, or perceived exertion when blood flow restriction (BFR) was added to a single balance exercise session.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，在久坐不动成年人的单次平衡训练中，附加血流限制（BFR）并未带来额外的神经肌肉和姿势控制急性益处。这意味着如果您在临床中考虑使用BFR辅助平衡训练，需要更深入地研究重复性训练的效果，而不应期望单次会话就能产生显著急性增益。
items.titleZh: 久坐成年人平衡运动结合血流限制对急性神经肌肉和姿势控制反应的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项三臂随机对照试验（n=74名健康久坐成年人）发现，在单次平衡训练中附加血流限制（BFR）并未对姿势控制、本体感觉、功能表现或感知劳累带来额外的急性益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that adding blood flow restriction (BFR) to a single balance exercise session did not provide additional acute neuromuscular and postural control benefits in sedentary adults. This means if you are considering using BFR to assist balance training in clinical practice, further research on the effects of repeated training is needed, and you should not expect significant acute gains from a single session.
items.limitation: 本研究为单次干预的急性效应研究，未能评估重复BFR辅助平衡训练的长期效果。
items.limitationEn: This study investigated acute effects of a single intervention, failing to assess the long-term effects of repeated BFR-supported balance training.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Altered Cognitive Control and Cortical Oscillatory Dynamics in Athletes With ACL Reconstruction During Decision-Making Under Uncertainty.
items.summary: In 90 open-skill athletes (45 non-ACLR, 45 ACLR), ACLR athletes showed slower response times and lower accuracy (d = 0.75-1.09) during a probabilistic go/no-go task, with attenuated midfrontal theta power prestimulus and elevated power during the target phase, reflecting a shift to reactive cognitive control, impaired motor cortical disinhibition, and less efficient visual-attentional resource deployment.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明 ACLR 运动员在不确定决策情境下，存在持续的认知控制和皮层振荡动态改变，即便常规评估可能未发现。这提示你在重返运动方案中应整合神经认知评估，以识别再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建运动员在不确定决策情境下认知控制和皮层振荡动态的改变
items.summaryZh: 在 90 名开放技能运动员（45 名非 ACLR，45 名 ACLR）中，ACLR 运动员在概率性 Go/No-Go 任务中表现出较慢的反应时间和较低的准确性（d = 0.75-1.09）。其前刺激阶段中额叶 theta 波功率减弱，目标阶段功率升高，反映了认知控制向反应性模式的转变、运动皮层去抑制受损以及视觉注意力资源分配效率降低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study shows that ACLR athletes exhibit persistent alterations in cognitive control and cortical oscillatory dynamics during uncertain decision-making, even when standard assessments may not detect them. This indicates that neurocognitive assessments should be integrated into return-to-sport protocols to identify reinjury risk.
items.limitation: 本研究为对照实验室研究，运动场景复杂性与实验室环境存在差异，结果向真实比赛情境的外推性需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a controlled laboratory study, and the complexity of sport scenarios differs from laboratory settings, so the generalizability of results to real-game situations should be considered cautiously.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Diagnosis, Rehabilitation, and Return to Sport after Athletic Hamstring Injury: An ICCUS Society Consensus Statement.
items.summary: An ICCUS Society modified Delphi consensus (n=17 experts) for athletic hamstring injuries (AHSI) achieved consensus on 54 statements (mean agreement 89.88%), supporting standardized terminology, MRI/ultrasound for diagnosis, individualized and criterion-based rehabilitation, progressive tissue loading, early neuromuscular control, gradual running/agility progression, pain-free sprinting, objective strength assessment, sport-specific workloads, and athlete readiness as key RTS criteria.
items.curatedReason: 这份国际运动临床超声学会 (ICCUS) 的共识声明为腘绳肌损伤的分类、康复和重返运动提供了实用的统一框架。它强调以可衡量进展为导向的主动康复，你应将其作为临床实践和决策的重要参考。
items.titleZh: 运动性腘绳肌损伤的诊断、康复和重返运动：ICCUS 学会共识声明
items.summaryZh: 国际运动临床超声学会 (ICCUS) 对运动性腘绳肌损伤 (AHSI) 的一项改良 Delphi 共识（n=17 位专家）就 54 项声明达成共识（平均同意度 89.88%），支持标准化术语、MRI/超声诊断、个体化和基于标准的康复、渐进性组织负荷、早期神经肌肉控制、逐步跑步/敏捷性进展、无痛冲刺、客观力量评估、专项运动负荷以及运动员准备度作为关键的重返运动标准。
items.curatedReasonEn: This ICCUS Society consensus statement provides a practical, unified framework for the classification, rehabilitation, and return to sport after athletic hamstring injury. It emphasizes active rehabilitation guided by measurable progress and should be a key reference for your clinical practice and decision-making.
items.limitation: 本共识声明基于 Delphi 专家调查，其证据强度受限于专家意见的聚合，而非前瞻性研究。
items.limitationEn: This consensus statement is based on a Delphi expert survey, and its evidence strength is limited by the aggregation of expert opinions rather than prospective studies.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Neurocognitive Factors in ACL Injury: The Missing Piece in Rehabilitation and Prevention? A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 42 studies identified dual-task interference and visual attention as the most investigated neurocognitive domains in ACL injury. Neurocognitive training interventions show potential benefits in visuomotor efficiency, movement compliance, and return to sport readiness, suggesting neurocognitive factors are a missing component in current ACL rehabilitation and prevention frameworks.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述指出，神经认知因素是当前 ACL 康复和预防框架中缺失的重要部分。它强调了将神经认知挑战整合到康复和重返运动测试中的潜力，能帮助你更早识别再损伤风险，从而优化训练方案。
items.titleZh: ACL 损伤中的神经认知因素：康复与预防中缺失的一环？一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 42 项研究的范围综述发现，双任务干扰和视觉注意力是 ACL 损伤中最受关注的神经认知领域。神经认知训练干预在视觉运动效率、运动依从性和 ACL 康复后重返运动准备方面显示出潜在益处，表明神经认知因素是当前 ACL 康复和预防框架中缺失的重要组成部分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review highlights neurocognitive factors as a major missing component in current ACL rehabilitation and prevention frameworks. It emphasizes the potential of integrating neurocognitive challenges into rehabilitation and RTS testing to better identify athletes at risk for secondary injury, thus optimizing training protocols.
items.limitation: 目前证据主要来自实验室和探索性研究，前瞻性和临床转化数据有限，仍需进一步的高质量研究。
items.limitationEn: Current evidence is predominantly derived from laboratory-based and exploratory studies with limited prospective and clinically translational data, requiring further high-quality research.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Adherence System Usability Patient Experience and Psychosocial Impact in Robot Assisted Gait Neurorehabilitation A Cross Sectional Study.
items.summary: In a single-center observational study of 250 adults with neurological conditions, greater adherence (mean participation 86.35%), system usability (mean SUS 72.79), and neurorehabilitation experience (mean NREQ 27.84) were associated with a favorable psychosocial impact (mean PIADS 1.67), with adherence correlating with SUS (r s = 0.41), NREQ (r s = 0.49), and PIADS (r s = 0.53; all p < 0.001).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调，在机器人辅助步态神经康复中，患者的依从性、可用性体验和康复体验与更好的心理社会影响相关。这提示你，除了技术本身，关注患者使用体验和心理社会因素能进一步优化康复效果。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态神经康复中依从性系统可用性、患者体验和心理社会影响的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 250 名神经系统疾病成年人的单中心观察研究发现，更高的依从性（平均参与度 86.35%）、系统可用性（平均 SUS 72.79）和神经康复体验（平均 NREQ 27.84）与积极的心理社会影响（平均 PIADS 1.67）相关，其中依从性与 SUS (r s = 0.41)、NREQ (r s = 0.49) 和 PIADS (r s = 0.53) 均显著相关（所有 p < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights that greater adherence, usability experience, and rehabilitation experience are associated with favorable psychosocial impact in robot-assisted gait neurorehabilitation. This suggests that focusing on patient experience and psychosocial factors, beyond the technology itself, can further optimize rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性研究，且问卷评估与依从性存在时间错配，无法确立因果关系或功能改善。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational study, with simultaneous questionnaire assessment and temporal mismatch with attendance, precluding causal mediation or functional improvement.

items.title: Gamified Versus Traditional Balance Training: Effects on Balance and Motivation in Collegiate Student-Athletes.
items.summary: A quasi-experimental trial (n=30) found gamified (Wii Fit) and traditional (wobble board) balance training similarly improved mSEBT composite scores (gamified: +21.6 ± 11.9 cm, d = 1.84; traditional: +18.5 ± 14.6 cm, d = 1.54) compared to control (p < 0.01). Gamified training resulted in higher intrinsic motivation (5.0 ± 1.2 vs. 3.2 ± 1.3; p < 0.01, d = 1.50).
items.curatedReason: 如果你的目标是提升年轻运动员的动态平衡，Wii Fit 这类游戏化训练，在效果上和传统平衡板没差，但可能让患者更享受。在预算允许的情况下，不妨考虑用游戏化方案提高患者依从性。
items.titleZh: 游戏化与传统平衡训练：对大学学生运动员平衡和动机的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项准实验试验（n=30）发现，游戏化（Wii Fit）和传统（摇摆板）平衡训练在改善改良星形平衡测试（mSEBT）综合评分方面效果相似（游戏化：+21.6 ± 11.9 厘米，d = 1.84；传统：+18.5 ± 14.6 厘米，d = 1.54），均优于对照组（p < 0.01）。游戏化训练带来了更高的内在动机（5.0 ± 1.2 vs. 3.2 ± 1.3；p < 0.01，d = 1.50）。
items.curatedReasonEn: When improving dynamic balance in young athletes, gamified training (like Wii Fit) can be as effective as traditional wobble board exercises, but with higher intrinsic motivation. Consider incorporating gamified solutions to boost patient adherence if your budget allows.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本准实验研究，随机化程度较低且仅评估了短期效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a small sample, quasi-experimental study with pseudo-randomization and only assessed short-term effects.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Ultrasound-Guided Percutaneous Tendon Dry Needling for Recalcitrant Distal Biceps Tendinopathy: A Case Series.
items.summary: This case series (n=2) suggests that ultrasound-guided percutaneous tendon dry needling with fenestration, adjunct to a graded loading program, may contribute to reduced pain and disability at 6 months for chronic distal biceps tendinopathy, with both subjects exceeding the minimal clinically important difference for outcome measures.
items.curatedReason: 本案例系列提示，超声引导下干针联合分级负重计划可能有助于缓解远端肱二头肌肌腱病患者的疼痛和功能障碍。在缺乏高级别证据的情况下，你可考虑将其作为辅助治疗手段。
items.titleZh: 超声引导经皮肌腱干针治疗顽固性远端肱二头肌肌腱病变：一个病例系列
items.summaryZh: 该病例系列（n=2）表明，超声引导下经皮肌腱干针联合分级负重计划，在慢性远端肱二头肌肌腱病变患者中，可能有助于在 6 个月时减轻疼痛和功能障碍，两名受试者的各项结局指标均超出了最小临床重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series suggests that ultrasound-guided dry needling combined with a graded loading program may help reduce pain and disability in individuals with distal biceps tendinopathy. Consider it as an adjunctive treatment, pending higher-level evidence.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本案例系列，证据级别较低，且未设对照组，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a small case series with a low level of evidence and no control group, preventing causal conclusions.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Conservative and Post-Operative Rehabilitation Protocols for Hip Dysplasia in Adolescents to Adulthood: A Literature Review.
items.summary: A literature review of 12 sources on hip dysplasia (DDH) in adolescents and adults aged 13-50 years found physiotherapy is a central component of conservative and post-operative rehabilitation, with multimodal, criterion-based approaches incorporating progressive strengthening and neuromuscular retraining most consistently described, despite limitations in methodological heterogeneity and sample size.
items.curatedReason: 这份文献综述确认物理治疗在青少年至成年髋关节发育不良 (DDH) 的保守和术后康复中居核心地位。它提示你，尽管证据异质性高，但多模式、基于标准的渐进性强化和神经肌肉再训练是目前较为一致的策略。
items.titleZh: 青少年至成年髋关节发育不良的保守及术后康复方案：文献综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 12 篇关于 13-50 岁青少年和成年髋关节发育不良 (DDH) 文献的综述发现，物理治疗是保守和术后康复的核心组成部分，尽管存在方法学异质性和样本量小的局限性，但多模式、基于标准的渐进性强化和神经肌肉再训练是最常被描述的方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This literature review confirms the central role of physiotherapy in both conservative and post-operative rehabilitation for developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) in adolescents to adults. It suggests that while evidence heterogeneity is high, multimodal, criterion-based progressive strengthening and neuromuscular retraining are the most consistently described strategies.
items.limitation: 现有证据基础受限于方法学异质性、样本量小和依赖专家共识，缺乏高质量比较试验。
items.limitationEn: The current evidence base is limited by methodological heterogeneity, small sample sizes, and reliance on expert consensus, with no high-quality comparative trials identified.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Cardiorespiratory training after stroke or transient ischemic attack in the United Kingdom: A national survey.
items.summary: A UK national online survey (n=253) on cardiorespiratory training after stroke/TIA found provision varied, with people with minimal disability more likely to receive it. Key concerns included serious adverse events, fatigue, and falls, while barriers involved service commissioning, resources, skills/knowledge, and lack of guidelines.
items.curatedReason: 这项英国全国性调查揭示了卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）后心肺训练的提供现状、风险认知和实施障碍。它提醒你，服务的可及性和质量存在不平等，尤其是对残疾程度较高的患者，需要更多资源、技能和指南支持。
items.titleZh: 英国卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作后的心肺训练：一项全国性调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对英国卒中/短暂性脑缺血发作后心肺训练的全国在线调查（n=253）发现，服务提供情况各异，残疾程度较低者更有可能接受训练。主要担忧包括严重不良事件、疲劳和跌倒，而障碍则包括服务委托、资源、技能/知识和缺乏指南。
items.curatedReasonEn: This UK national survey reveals the current provision, perceived risks, and barriers to delivering cardiorespiratory training after stroke and TIA. It highlights inequalities in service accessibility and quality, especially for patients with greater disability, underscoring the need for more resources, skills, and guideline support.
items.limitation: 本研究为在线调查，可能存在报告偏差和自选择偏倚，不能完全代表所有英国物理治疗师和运动专业人员的观点。
items.limitationEn: This was an online survey, potentially subject to reporting bias and self-selection bias, and may not fully represent the views of all UK physiotherapists and exercise professionals.

items.title: Effects of Medium-frequency Electrical Stimulation Combined with Near-Infrared Light on Quadriceps Function and Independent Walking in Patients with Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A two-phase study (Phase I: 36 SCI patients, 15 controls; Phase II: 18 SCI patients) explored combined medium-frequency electrical stimulation and near-infrared therapy, suggesting potential improvements in quadriceps activation, femoral artery blood-flow velocity, and walking ability in SCI patients, though findings are preliminary.
items.curatedReason: 初步证据提示中频电刺激结合近红外光可能改善脊髓损伤患者的股四头肌激活、股动脉血流速度和步行能力。但该研究样本量小（18 例 SCI 患者）、非随机、无对照组随机化，别急着引入常规方案，需等待更大规模的 RCT 验证。
items.titleZh: 中频电刺激联合近红外光对脊髓损伤患者股四头肌功能和独立行走能力的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段研究（I 期：36 例脊髓损伤患者与 15 例健康对照；II 期：18 例脊髓损伤患者）初步探索了中频电刺激联合近红外疗法，提示其可能改善脊髓损伤患者的股四头肌激活、股动脉血流速度和步行能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Preliminary evidence suggests that medium-frequency electrical stimulation combined with near-infrared light may improve quadriceps activation, femoral artery blood-flow velocity, and walking ability in patients with spinal cord injury. However, the study involved a small sample size (18 SCI patients), was nonrandomized, and lacked randomized control, so avoid premature integration into routine protocols and await confirmation from larger RCTs.
items.limitation: 研究样本量小，为非随机对照设计，结果仍需大规模随机对照研究确认。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size and a nonrandomized controlled design; results require confirmation from larger randomized studies.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Development of a Single-Camera Markerless Motion Capture System for Assessing Upper Limb Function Post-Stroke (FULMA).
items.summary: The Functional Upper Limb Movement Assessment (FULMA) system, a single-camera markerless motion capture tool, achieved 83.3% mean accuracy in predicting ordinal task performance scores for upper limb function post-stroke, showing preliminary agreement with therapist ratings in 39 stroke participants and 19 healthy controls.
items.curatedReason: 这款单摄像头、无标记运动捕捉系统（FULMA）在卒中后上肢功能评估上，初步显示出与职能治疗师评级一致性高。虽然仍处于开发阶段，但它为客观量化卒中康复的精细运动变化提供了潜力，可作为未来技术在临床实践中的风向标。
items.titleZh: 用于评估卒中后上肢功能的单摄像头无标记运动捕捉系统（FULMA）的开发
items.summaryZh: 功能性上肢运动评估系统（FULMA）是一款单摄像头无标记运动捕捉工具，在 39 名卒中患者和 19 名健康对照者中，预测上肢功能任务表现评分的平均准确度达到 83.3%，初步显示与治疗师评分的一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This single-camera markerless motion capture system (FULMA) shows promising preliminary agreement with occupational therapist ratings for post-stroke upper limb function assessment. While still in development, it offers potential for objectively quantifying subtle motor changes in stroke rehabilitation, serving as a bellwether for future technological integration into clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项早期开发研究，需要在更广阔的临床环境中进行外部验证和测量属性评估。
items.limitationEn: This was an early development study and requires external validation and evaluation of measurement properties in broader clinical settings.

items.title: What are the barriers and facilitators to engagement with physiotherapy among women experiencing adverse effects associated with menopause?
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=12) identified fatigue, cognitive issues, low self-efficacy, and negative language as barriers to physiotherapy engagement for women with menopause-related MSK pain, while direct inquiry about menopause and feeling listened to were facilitators.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了围绝经期女性在寻求物理治疗以缓解肌肉骨骼疼痛时面临的障碍（如疲劳、认知问题、自我效能低、医疗人员的负面语言）和促进因素（如直接询问更年期情况、被倾听）。了解这些能帮助你更好地与这类患者沟通和制定个性化治疗计划。
items.titleZh: 围绝经期女性参与物理治疗以缓解相关副作用的障碍和促进因素是什么？
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究（n=12）发现，疲劳、认知问题、低自我效能感和医疗专业人员的负面语言是围绝经期肌肉骨骼疼痛女性参与物理治疗的障碍，而直接询问更年期情况和被倾听则是促进因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For women with menopause-related MSK pain, directly asking about menopause and actively listening to their fatigue and cognitive issues can significantly improve physiotherapy engagement. The study suggests that avoiding negative language and addressing self-efficacy will help you better support these patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（12 名），结果的普遍性受限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (12 participants), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Investigating the Feasibility of Locomotor Training for Children Under 5 Years With Complex Neurodisabilties.
items.summary: A single-group pre-post study (n=71, mean age 2.8 years) found a 6-week locomotor training program feasible and beneficial for young children with neurodisabilities, showing improvements in Goal Attainment Scaling (12.8 to 56.2) and other mobility outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，步态训练对于 5 岁以下患有复杂神经功能障碍的儿童是可行且有益的。如果你在儿科康复中遇到有严重运动障碍的幼儿，这提示你可以考虑将步态训练纳入其治疗计划。
items.titleZh: 探讨 5 岁以下复杂神经功能障碍儿童步态训练的可行性。
items.summaryZh: 一项单组前后对照研究（n=71，平均年龄 2.8 岁）发现，为患有神经功能障碍的幼儿实施为期 6 周的步态训练计划是可行且有益的，其目标达成量表得分从 12.8 提高到 56.2，其他运动功能结果也得到改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that locomotor training is feasible and beneficial for children under 5 with complex neurodisabilities. If you work with young children with significant motor impairments in pediatric rehabilitation, this indicates that locomotor training could be considered in their treatment plans.
items.limitation: 本研究为单组研究，缺乏对照组，无法排除其他因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-group study without a control group, making it difficult to exclude the influence of other factors.
items.journal: Pediatric physical therapy : the official publication of the Section on Pediatrics of the American Physical Therapy Association

items.title: Remote Ischemic Conditioning Modulates Spinal Reflex Excitability in Healthy Young Adults: A Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A pilot RCT found that remote ischemic conditioning (RIC) paired with balance training reduced the Hslp/Mslp ratio (p=0.02) and improved balance performance (p=0.02) more than sham in healthy young adults, suggesting RIC may augment neuroplastic adaptations.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步的 RCT 结果表明，远程缺血预处理 (RIC) 结合平衡训练可能对健康年轻人产生神经生理学和行为上的益处，有望改善平衡表现。虽然只是初步证据，你可以关注 RIC 作为运动学习生理启动子的潜力。
items.titleZh: 远程缺血预处理调节健康年轻成人脊髓反射兴奋性的初步随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项初步随机对照试验发现，在健康年轻成人中，远程缺血预处理 (RIC) 结合平衡训练相比假治疗更能降低 Hslp/Mslp 比值 (p=0.02) 并改善平衡表现 (p=0.02)，表明 RIC 可能增强神经可塑性适应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that remote ischemic conditioning (RIC) paired with balance training may offer neurophysiological and behavioral benefits, potentially improving balance performance in healthy young adults. While preliminary, you should monitor the potential of RIC as a physiological primer for motor learning.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步的随机对照试验，样本量小，且仅针对健康年轻成人，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot RCT with a small sample size and was conducted only on healthy young adults, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Neurological and functional recovery despite persistent skull defect after decompressive hemicraniectomy: a case report.
items.summary: A case report of a 60-year-old man who showed neurological and functional improvements beyond 6 months post-stroke despite a persistent skull defect after decompressive hemicraniectomy and extensive cortical resection.
items.curatedReason: 这例报告表明，即使在减压半颅骨切除术后颅骨缺损持续存在，患者的神经和功能恢复仍可超出 6 个月。它强调了在这种复杂情况下，康复目标和优先级的适应性调整对患者功能改善的重要性。
items.titleZh: 减压半颅骨切除术后颅骨缺损持续存在下的神经和功能恢复：一例病例报告。
items.summaryZh: 一例 60 岁男性患者在卒中后 6 个月，尽管减压半颅骨切除术和广泛皮质切除后颅骨缺损持续存在，但其神经和功能仍有改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report illustrates that neurological and functional recovery can continue beyond 6 months despite persistent skull defects after decompressive hemicraniectomy. It highlights the importance of adaptive rehabilitation goal setting and prioritization for functional improvement in complex cases.
items.limitation: 本研究为单例病例报告，无法推断普遍结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, and its findings cannot be generalized.

items.title: Evaluating ChatGPTs Responses to Chiropractic Patient Questions: A Comparative Study
items.summary: A study evaluating ChatGPT (GPT-5.2) responses to chiropractic patient questions found broad concordance with clinical practice guidelines, with high mean ratings for relevance (4.72), clarity (4.76), completeness (4.23), and accuracy (4.00), but poor inter-rater reliability among chiropractors.
items.curatedReason: ChatGPT (GPT-5.2) 在回答脊骨神经科患者问题时，与临床指南有广泛一致性，且在相关性、清晰度、完整性和准确性上得分均高于4.00。然而，请注意它在可读性上可能超出患者推荐标准，且专业人员间的解读一致性差，这提示你不能完全依赖AI来做患者教育。
items.titleZh: 评估 ChatGPT 对脊骨神经科患者提问的回答：一项比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项评估 ChatGPT (GPT-5.2) 对脊骨神经科患者提问的回答研究发现，其与临床实践指南广泛一致，相关性 (4.72)、清晰度 (4.76)、完整性 (4.23) 和准确性 (4.00) 的平均评分较高，但脊骨神经科医生间的评价一致性较差。
items.curatedReasonEn: ChatGPT (GPT-5.2) responses to chiropractic patient questions show broad concordance with clinical guidelines and scored above 4.00 for relevance, clarity, completeness, and accuracy. However, be aware that its readability may exceed recommended patient standards, and inter-rater reliability among professionals is poor, suggesting you shouldn't rely solely on AI for patient education.
items.limitation: 本研究评估了特定版本的 ChatGPT (GPT-5.2)，其结果可能不适用于未来更新的模型。
items.limitationEn: This study evaluated a specific version of ChatGPT (GPT-5.2), and its findings may not apply to future updated models.

items.title: Comparative study of therapeutic ultrasound and whole-body vibration as adjuncts to passive stretching on knee joint range of motion and functional ability in children with hemiplegic cerebral palsy: a randomized trial
items.summary: A randomized trial (n=60 children aged 4-6 years with hemiplegic cerebral palsy) compared therapeutic ultrasound (US) and whole-body vibration (WBV) as adjuncts to passive stretching. The WBV group showed significantly greater improvements in active knee extension ROM (13.82% vs 7.05%) and GMFM scores (22.72% vs 11.32%) over 12 weeks (p<0.01).
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，在脑瘫儿童的拉伸治疗中，全身振动作为辅助手段比治疗性超声效果更优，能显著提升膝关节活动度和粗大运动功能。在临床实践中，应优先考虑全身振动作为辅助干预来增强脑瘫患儿的康复效果。
items.titleZh: 治疗性超声与全身振动作为被动拉伸辅助疗法对偏瘫型脑瘫儿童膝关节活动度和功能能力的比较研究：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机试验（n=60名4-6岁偏瘫型脑瘫儿童）比较了治疗性超声（US）和全身振动（WBV）作为被动拉伸的辅助疗法。WBV组在12周后在主动膝关节伸展活动度（13.82% vs 7.05%）和粗大运动功能量表得分（22.72% vs 11.32%）方面显示出显著更大的改善（p<0.01）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that whole-body vibration as an adjunct to stretching is superior to therapeutic ultrasound for improving knee range of motion and gross motor function in children with cerebral palsy. In clinical practice, prioritize whole-body vibration as an adjunctive intervention to enhance rehabilitation outcomes for children with cerebral palsy.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于4-6岁的偏瘫型脑瘫儿童，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to children with hemiplegic cerebral palsy aged 4-6 years, so generalization of results should be cautious.

items.title: Physical exercise therapy for autism spectrum disorder: a scoping review of systematic reviews
items.summary: A scoping review of 50 systematic reviews (published 2013-2025) on physical exercise therapy (PET) for individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) found that PET may improve motor, social, behavioral, and sleep outcomes. However, the findings are limited by low methodological quality, high heterogeneity, and lack of long-term follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 现有证据提示体育锻炼疗法（PET）可能改善自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）患者的运动技能、社交沟通、刻板行为、执行功能和睡眠质量，但证据质量普遍较低且异质性高。你在临床实践中可以尝试将 PET 作为辅助干预，但须认识到其证据强度仍需更高质量研究支持。
items.titleZh: 自闭症谱系障碍的体育锻炼疗法：系统综述的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对50篇系统综述（2013-2025年发表）的范围综述发现，体育锻炼疗法（PET）可能改善自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）患者的运动、社交、行为和睡眠结局。然而，这些发现受限于方法学质量低、异质性高及缺乏长期随访。
items.curatedReasonEn: Current evidence suggests physical exercise therapy (PET) may improve motor skills, social communication, stereotyped behaviors, executive function, and sleep quality in individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD), but evidence quality is generally low with high heterogeneity. You can try PET as an adjunctive intervention in clinical practice, but recognize that stronger evidence from higher-quality studies is still needed.
items.limitation: 纳入的系统综述方法学质量普遍较低至极低，结果异质性高，且缺乏长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: Included systematic reviews had generally low to critically low methodological quality, high heterogeneity, and lacked long-term follow-up data.

items.title:
The first Archives of Physiotherapy Best Paper Awards: recognizing research that advances the profession
							| Archives of Physiotherapy
items.summary: Archives of Physiotherapy announced its first Best Paper Awards for an original research article and a systematic review published in 2025. The original research explored physiotherapy dose and motor recovery post-stroke, while the systematic review compared loaded vs unloaded exercise for chronic low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 《物理治疗档案》首次评选出了最佳论文，强调了高质量研究在推进物理治疗专业方面的重要性。其中提及的两篇获奖论文，一篇关注卒中后物理治疗剂量与运动恢复的关系，另一篇系统综述比较了负重与非负重运动在慢性腰痛管理中的效果，这些发现可指导你在实践中更精准地评估治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 《物理治疗档案》首届最佳论文奖：表彰推动专业发展的研究
items.summaryZh: 《物理治疗档案》公布了首届最佳论文奖，表彰了2025年发表的一篇原创研究文章和一篇系统综述。原创研究探讨了卒中后物理治疗剂量与运动恢复的关系，系统综述则比较了负重与非负重运动在慢性腰痛管理中的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: Archives of Physiotherapy awarded its first Best Paper Awards, highlighting the importance of high-quality research in advancing the PT profession. Two winning papers discussed the association of physiotherapy dose with motor recovery post-stroke and compared loaded versus unloaded exercise for chronic low back pain, offering guidance for precise treatment evaluation.

items.title: From Signal to Biological Meaning: A Systematic Review of Construct-Validity Evidence for External Training Load Metrics in Sport
items.summary: A systematic review of 46 studies found that most external training load (ETL) metrics are supported as descriptions of external movement or exposure rather than direct indicators of biological demand or response. Direct construct-matched evidence was uncommon, and methodological limitations reduced confidence in biological interpretations.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述指出，大多数外部训练负荷（ETL）指标更多地描述了外部运动和做功，而非直接的生理需求或反应。在运动康复和训练监控中，不要盲目将 ETL 数据解读为直接的生理负荷，应明确其构建效度并结合生理指标综合评估，避免过度推断。
items.titleZh: 从信号到生物学意义：运动中外部训练负荷指标构建效度证据的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对46项研究的系统综述发现，大多数外部训练负荷（ETL）指标被支持为外部运动或暴露的描述，而非直接的生物需求或反应指标。直接的构建效度证据不常见，方法学局限性降低了对生物学解释的信心。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review indicates that most external training load (ETL) metrics primarily describe external movement and work, rather than direct biological demands or responses. In sports rehabilitation and training monitoring, avoid blindly interpreting ETL data as direct physiological load. Instead, combine it with physiological indicators for comprehensive assessment, preventing over-inference.
items.limitation: 各指标、目标构建、比较器和研究设计的异质性高，限制了 Meta 分析，证据链有方法学局限。
items.limitationEn: High heterogeneity across metrics, target constructs, comparators, and study designs limited meta-analysis, and evidence chains had methodological limitations.

items.title: Lumbar mobility and strength correlate with low back pain and quality of life
items.summary: A retrospective cross-sectional study (n=1,309 adults) found that STS, FFD, and Idiag M360 thoracolumbar flexion/extension were significantly associated with SF36-PF and SF36-BP (all p ≤ 0.002) in both chronic low back pain (cLBP) and non-cLBP groups. Greater STS performance and higher thoracolumbar flexion/extension were associated with lower odds of cLBP (all p ≤ 0.001).
items.curatedReason: 功能性力量和腰椎活动度与慢性下腰痛及生活质量的关联再次得到佐证。我们在评估患者时，确实应该重视 STS 表现和设备辅助的腰椎活动度测量，它们是判断 cLBP 风险和患者预后的重要指标。
items.titleZh: 腰椎活动度和力量与下腰痛及生活质量相关
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性横断面研究（n=1,309名成人）发现，坐站试验（STS）、指尖触地试验（FFD）和Idiag M360胸腰椎屈伸活动度在慢性下腰痛（cLBP）和非cLBP组中均与SF36-PF和SF36-BP显著相关（均p ≤ 0.002）。STS表现更佳和胸腰椎屈伸活动度更高与cLBP的较低几率相关（均p ≤ 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The link between functional strength, thoracolumbar mobility, chronic low back pain, and quality of life is reaffirmed. When assessing patients, prioritize STS performance and device-assisted lumbar mobility measurements; they are key indicators for cLBP risk and patient prognosis.
items.limitation: 回顾性横断面研究，无法确定因果关系，且未评估这些测量方法对预后的预测能力。
items.limitationEn: Retrospective cross-sectional study, unable to determine causality, and did not assess the predictive ability of these measurements for outcomes.

items.title: Impact of comfortable nursing combined with diversified health education on self-management behavior in elderly patients with cardiovascular diseases
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=142 elderly CVD inpatients) found that a joint group receiving comfort care combined with diversified health education significantly improved CSMS total scores (116.00 vs 98.00, p<0.001) and SF-36 scores compared to a conventional group. Treatment adherence showed a favorable trend (92.96% vs 81.69%, p=0.044).
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究显示，舒适护理结合多元化健康教育模式可显著改善老年心血管疾病患者的自我管理能力和生活质量，但治疗依从性改善趋势需进一步验证。此模式为护理而非物理治疗主导，你在与护理团队协作时可参考。
items.titleZh: 舒适护理结合多元化健康教育对老年心血管疾病患者自我管理行为的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=142名老年心血管疾病住院患者）发现，与常规组相比，接受舒适护理结合多元化健康教育的联合组在CSMS总分（116.00 vs 98.00, p<0.001）和SF-36得分方面均显著改善。治疗依从性显示出有利趋势（92.96% vs 81.69%, p=0.044）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study suggests that combining comfort care with diversified health education can significantly improve self-management and quality of life in elderly cardiovascular disease patients, although the trend in treatment adherence requires further validation. This model is nursing-led rather than PT-led; you may refer to it when collaborating with nursing teams.
items.limitation: 回顾性研究设计且未随机分组，可能存在混杂因素；干预主要为护理和健康教育，非物理治疗。
items.limitationEn: Retrospective study design with non-randomized groups, potential confounders; interventions were primarily nursing and health education, not physical therapy.

items.title: Effectiveness of Plyometric Exercises Versus Flatfoot Corrective Exercises on Balance and Foot Posture in Obese Children with a Flexible Flatfoot: A Comparative Study
items.summary: An 8-week comparative study in 120 obese children with flexible flatfoot found that both plyometric and flatfoot corrective exercises improved foot posture and balance; however, plyometric training showed greater gains in balance (median path length: 30.39 cm vs. 37.45 cm, p < 0.001) and slightly better foot posture improvements for the left foot (p = 0.028).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，针对肥胖扁平足儿童，弹跳训练在改善平衡方面优于传统矫正练习，这是为儿童足部姿态和步态训练选择干预方法时的重要考量。
items.titleZh: 弹跳训练与扁平足矫正训练对肥胖伴柔韧性扁平足儿童平衡和足部姿态的有效性比较：一项比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 120 名肥胖伴柔韧性扁平足儿童的 8 周比较研究发现，弹跳训练和扁平足矫正训练都能改善足部姿态和平衡；但弹跳训练在平衡方面取得了更大的改善（中位路径长度：30.39 厘米 vs 37.45 厘米，p < 0.001），左足足部姿态改善也略好（p = 0.028）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that plyometric exercises are superior to traditional corrective exercises for improving balance in obese children with flexible flatfoot, which is an important consideration when selecting interventions for pediatric foot posture and gait training.
items.limitation: 这是一项非随机的平行比较研究，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a non-randomized comparative study, which may be subject to selection bias.

items.title: A Retrospective Real-World Assessment of Motor Status After Stroke Using a Home-Based Brain-Computer Interface
items.summary: A retrospective observational study of 452 stroke survivors using at-home BCI therapy found mean UEFM scores improved by 4.3 points at 12 weeks, reached the MCID (5.25 points) by 16 weeks, and continued to increase to 8.1 points at 52 weeks, especially in patients with severe chronic impairment.
items.curatedReason: 这项真实世界的回顾性研究表明，在家使用脑机接口 (BCI) 疗法在常规护理中可为卒中幸存者提供持久的运动功能改善，特别是对于重度慢性功能障碍的患者。这支持了在临床实践中推广 BCI 辅助康复的可能性。
items.titleZh: 使用居家脑机接口对卒中后运动状态的真实世界回顾性评估
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 452 名使用居家脑机接口 (BCI) 疗法的卒中幸存者的回顾性观察研究发现，平均 UEFM 评分在 12 周时提高了 4.3 分，在 16 周时达到了最小临床重要差异 (MCID)，并在 52 周时持续增加到 8.1 分，尤其在重度慢性功能障碍患者中效果显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This real-world retrospective study suggests that at-home brain-computer interface (BCI) therapy provides sustained motor improvements for stroke survivors in routine care, particularly those with severe chronic impairment. This supports the potential for wider adoption of BCI-assisted rehabilitation in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，存在潜在的选择偏倚，且并非所有患者都完成了 1 年随访。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study with potential selection bias, and not all patients completed the 1-year follow-up.

items.title: Therapeutic acute intermittent hypoxia alters supraspinal neural control of lower limb movement in multiple sclerosis
items.summary: A sham-controlled, double-blind crossover trial in 23 adults with MS found that acute intermittent hypoxia therapy augmented activation in the basal ganglia, thalamus, and cortical motor regions during lower-limb movement, suggesting modulation of supraspinal motor circuitry.
items.curatedReason: 急性间歇性低氧疗法 (AIH) 似乎通过调节基底节-丘脑-皮质运动环路来改善多发性硬化症患者的下肢运动控制，这为 AIH 辅助神经康复提供了神经生理学基础。
items.titleZh: 急性间歇性低氧疗法改变多发性硬化症患者下肢运动的超脊髓神经控制
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 23 名多发性硬化症成年患者的假对照、双盲交叉试验发现，急性间歇性低氧疗法在下肢运动期间增强了基底节、丘脑和皮质运动区域的激活，提示其对超脊髓运动回路的调节作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) appears to improve lower limb motor control in individuals with multiple sclerosis by modulating the basal ganglia-thalamo-cortical motor loop, providing a neurophysiological basis for AIH-assisted neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这项初步研究的样本量相对较小，且需要进一步验证这些发现与临床功能改善之间的关系。
items.limitationEn: This preliminary study has a relatively small sample size, and further validation is needed regarding the link between these findings and clinical functional improvements.

items.title: Real-Time Ultrasound-Assisted Laryngeal Electromyography Using an In-Plane Trajectory View: A Prospective Feasibility Study
items.summary: This prospective feasibility study demonstrates that real-time ultrasound-assisted laryngeal electromyography, using an in-plane trajectory view, is a safe and effective method for diagnosing laryngeal neuropathies and guiding therapeutic injections.
items.curatedReason: 超声引导下的喉部肌电图术能提高诊断的准确性与安全性，对评估喉部神经病变和指导注射治疗很有用。
items.titleZh: 实时超声辅助平面内轨迹视图喉部肌电图术：一项前瞻性可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性可行性研究表明，在平面内轨迹视图下，实时超声辅助的喉部肌电图术是诊断喉部神经病变和指导治疗性注射的一种安全有效的方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Real-time ultrasound guidance for laryngeal electromyography improves diagnostic accuracy and safety, making it valuable for assessing laryngeal neuropathies and guiding injections.
items.limitation: 这是一项可行性研究，样本量小且缺乏对照组。
items.limitationEn: This is a feasibility study with a small sample size and no control group.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Treatment Planning in Physical and Rehabilitation Medicine: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 9 studies found that large language models (LLMs) showed promising capabilities in supporting rehabilitation treatment planning, with concordance with expert opinion reaching 98.75% after review, particularly in musculoskeletal and cardiovascular rehabilitation. However, reported hallucinations underscore the need for supervision and further high-quality studies.
items.curatedReason: 生成式 AI（特别是 LLM）在康复治疗计划中的应用潜力显著，但在整合到临床工作流程前，必须解决“幻觉”问题并进行严格的真实世界验证。请将 AI 辅助方案作为参考，并始终保持专家监督。
items.titleZh: 人工智能在物理与康复医学治疗计划中的作用：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含9项研究的系统综述发现，大型语言模型（LLM）在支持康复治疗计划方面展现出良好潜力，尤其在肌肉骨骼和心血管康复中，经专家审查后与专家意见的一致性可达98.75%。然而，研究报告的“幻觉”现象强调了监督和进一步高质量研究的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Generative AI, especially LLMs, shows significant potential in rehabilitation treatment planning, but must address "hallucinations" and undergo rigorous real-world validation before clinical integration. Treat AI-assisted plans as references, and always maintain expert supervision.
items.limitation: 本综述纳入的研究数量有限（9项），且AI工具与专家意见的一致性评估方法可能存在局限。
items.limitationEn: The review included a limited number of studies (9), and the assessment methods for AI tool concordance with expert opinion might have limitations.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Learned helplessness is associated with jump-landing biomechanics following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.
items.summary: In 33 individuals 2.78 ± 2.78 years post-ACLR, greater learned helplessness was moderately associated with greater peak knee abduction in the ACLR limb (r = 0.564, p = 0.001) during jump-landing. Weaker associations with hip flexion were also observed.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，重建前交叉韧带（ACLR）后患者的习得性无助感与跳-落地时的膝关节外翻力学有中度关联。在康复和重返运动评估中，除了关注生物力学，也别忽视患者的心理社会因素。
items.titleZh: 习得性无助与前交叉韧带重建术后的跳-落地生物力学相关
items.summaryZh: 在 33 名前交叉韧带重建术后 2.78 ± 2.78 年的个体中，较高的习得性无助感与重建侧肢体在跳-落地时的膝关节峰值外展角度呈中度相关（r = 0.564, p = 0.001）。同时观察到与髋关节屈曲的较弱关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates a moderate association between learned helplessness and knee abduction mechanics during jump-landing after ACLR. In rehabilitation and return-to-sport assessments, do not overlook psychosocial factors in addition to biomechanics.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（N=33），且参与者普遍习得性无助感评分较低，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (N=33), and participants generally had low learned helplessness scores, which might affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: A case-series exploring real-world postural behaviour change following physiotherapy for low back pain.
items.summary: This case series (N=5) found that real-world lumbar posture differed between days in three participants following a physiotherapy session for chronic low back pain, with four of five participants showing changes in end-range flexion consistent with postural advice. All five reported reduced disability.
items.curatedReason: 本系列病例研究提示可穿戴传感器能捕捉到腰痛患者在现实生活中的姿势行为，且部分行为改变与物理治疗师的建议相符。这为理解疼痛发生机制和个性化康复提供了初步线索，但效应归因仍需对照研究。
items.titleZh: 病例系列：探究腰痛物理治疗后现实世界姿势行为的改变
items.summaryZh: 这项病例系列研究（N=5）发现，在接受慢性腰痛物理治疗后，三名参与者在日常生活中腰椎姿势分布发生变化，且五分之四的参与者在终末屈曲时间方面显示出与姿势建议一致的改变。所有五名参与者均报告残疾程度减轻。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series suggests wearable sensors can capture real-world postural behaviors in low back pain patients, with some changes aligning with physiotherapy advice. This offers initial clues for understanding pain mechanisms and individualized rehabilitation, but attributing effects requires controlled studies.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本病例系列，未设对照组，无法将行为变化归因于干预，且发现仅为假说生成。
items.limitationEn: This is a small case series without a control group, limiting attribution of behavioral changes to intervention, and findings are hypothesis-generating.

items.title: Longitudinal correlations among the berg balance scale, falls efficacy scale, and morse fall scale: a secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A prospective correlational study of 66 older adults found that associations among Berg Balance Scale (BBS), Falls Efficacy Scale (FES), and Morse Fall Scale (MFS) increased over a 6-week period, with strong correlations observed by 6 weeks (r = −0.704 for BBS/MFS, r = 0.714 for FES/MFS).
items.curatedReason: 对老年人进行跌倒风险评估时，若只用单一量表，可能会错过动态变化。这项观察研究提示，BBS、FES 和 MFS 这三份量表之间的关联度会随时间增强，到第6周时达到强相关（如BBS/MFS的r=-0.704），这意味着动态追踪时，你可以更自信地将它们结合起来综合评估，尤其是评估周期稍长的情况。
items.titleZh: Berg 平衡量表、跌倒效能量表和 Morse 跌倒量表之间的纵向相关性：一项随机对照试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对66名老年人进行的前瞻性相关性研究发现，在 6 周的观察期内，Berg 平衡量表 (BBS)、跌倒效能量表 (FES) 和 Morse 跌倒量表 (MFS) 之间的关联性增强，并在第 6 周时观察到强相关性（BBS/MFS 为 r = −0.704，FES/MFS 为 r = 0.714）。
items.curatedReasonEn: When assessing fall risk in older adults, relying solely on one scale might miss dynamic changes. This observational study suggests that the association among BBS, FES, and MFS strengthens over time, reaching strong correlations by 6 weeks (e.g., r=-0.704 for BBS/MFS). This implies you can more confidently integrate these scales for comprehensive assessment during dynamic tracking, especially over slightly longer assessment periods.
items.limitation: 作为一项相关性研究，无法推断因果关系。样本量相对较小 (66名老年人)，且仅观察了 6 周。
items.limitationEn: As a correlational study, it cannot infer causality. The sample size is relatively small (66 older adults), and the observation period was only 6 weeks.
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: Effect of Data Processing Strategy on Maximal Oxygen Uptake and Plateau Identification in Collegiate Tennis Athletes
items.summary: This study investigates the effect of different data processing strategies on the identification of maximal oxygen uptake and plateau in collegiate tennis athletes, highlighting implications for accurate physiological assessment.
items.curatedReason: 在评估大学网球运动员的最大摄氧量时，不要以为数据处理方法都一样。这项观察研究提示，不同的数据处理策略会影响最大摄氧量和平台期的识别，这意味着你的评估结果可能因处理方式而异。
items.titleZh: 数据处理策略对大学网球运动员最大摄氧量和平台期识别的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项研究探讨了不同数据处理策略对大学网球运动员最大摄氧量和平台期识别的影响，强调了其对准确生理评估的意义。
items.curatedReasonEn: When assessing collegiate tennis players' maximal oxygen uptake, don't assume all data processing methods are equal. This observational study indicates that different data processing strategies impact the identification of maximal oxygen uptake and plateaus, meaning your assessment results could vary based on the method used.
items.limitation: 研究对象为大学网球运动员，结果外推到其他人群或运动类型可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on collegiate tennis athletes, limiting generalizability to other populations or sport types.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Smart Home Technology for Dementia Care: Supporting Aging in Place
items.summary: This article discusses smart home technology for dementia care, highlighting devices that support aging in place, their potential benefits, and limitations.
items.curatedReason: 智能家居技术是痴呆症患者居家养老的重要支持。作为康复师，你应该了解这些设备的潜在益处和局限性，以便为患者及其家属提供切实的、基于证据的环境改造和辅助技术建议。
items.titleZh: 用于痴呆症照护的智能家居技术：支持居家养老
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了用于痴呆症照护的智能家居技术，重点介绍了支持居家养老的设备及其潜在益处和局限性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Smart home technology is a crucial support for people with dementia to age in place. As a therapist, you should understand the potential benefits and limitations of these devices to provide practical, evidence-based advice on environmental modifications and assistive technology to patients and their families.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of Exercise Type and Duration on Pain, Function, and Quality of Life in Patients With Knee Osteoarthritis: A Systematic Review With Bayesian Network Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A Bayesian network meta-analysis of 35 trials (n=3808) found short-term combined aerobic and resistance exercise had the largest effect for pain (SMD = -0.937), function (SMD = -0.590), and QoL (SMD = 0.663) in patients with knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 本项贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析坐实了对膝骨关节炎患者，短期（≤12 周）有氧与阻抗联合运动能带来最大的疼痛、功能和生活质量改善。在给膝 OA 患者开运动处方时，应优先考虑联合训练。
items.titleZh: 运动类型和持续时间对膝骨关节炎患者疼痛、功能和生活质量的影响：一项贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 35 项试验（n=3808）的贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析显示，对于膝骨关节炎患者，短期有氧与阻抗联合运动对疼痛（SMD = -0.937）、功能（SMD = -0.590）和生活质量（SMD = 0.663）的改善效果最大。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Bayesian network meta-analysis confirms that for knee OA patients, short-term (≤12 weeks) combined aerobic and resistance exercise yields the greatest improvements in pain, function, and quality of life. Prioritize combined training when prescribing exercise for knee OA.
items.limitation: 证据确定性（GRADE）多为低或极低，长期干预的临床意义证据有限，需更多高质量研究支持。
items.limitationEn: Evidence certainty (GRADE) was mostly low or very low, and the clinical significance of long-term interventions was limited, warranting more high-quality studies.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: First-Hand Experience and the Value of Telerehabilitation for Chronic Knee Pain: A Discrete Choice Experiment Nested in a Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: In Australian adults with chronic knee pain, those with first-hand experience of telerehabilitation were willing to pay AU$87.49 (95% CI: 72.83, 102.14) more for telerehabilitation consultations than those who experienced in-person care, indicating a greater willingness to use and pay for it.
items.curatedReason: 有远程康复经验的患者，对远程康复的使用意愿和支付意愿明显更高。这提示你，对膝骨关节炎患者提供远程康复服务时，初次体验可能会显著影响其长期采纳度。
items.titleZh: 远程康复对慢性膝关节疼痛的价值：一项嵌套在随机对照试验中的离散选择实验
items.summaryZh: 一项在澳大利亚进行的针对慢性膝关节疼痛患者的研究发现，有过远程康复经验的患者比接受面对面护理的患者，对远程康复咨询的支付意愿高出 AU$87.49 (95% CI: 72.83, 102.14)，表明其更愿意使用并为此付费。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients with prior telerehabilitation experience show significantly higher willingness to use and pay for it. This suggests that for knee OA patients, the initial experience with telerehabilitation may significantly influence long-term adoption.
items.limitation: 本研究基于离散选择实验和随机对照试验的嵌套设计，结果对外推至真实世界决策仍需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study's nested design within a DCE and RCT warrants caution in generalizing results to real-world decision-making.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Does low back pain improve following supervised patient education and exercise therapy targeting hip osteoarthritis symptoms? A longitudinal cohort study of 5014 patients.
items.summary: Among 5014 patients with hip OA, 61% reported comorbid LBP. Participation in the GLA:D® program was associated with significant LBP reductions of 19% at 3 months and 21% at 12 months, particularly among hip OA responders.
items.curatedReason: 这项大规模队列研究提示，GLA:D® 计划对髋骨关节炎患者的腰痛也有效，特别是髋关节疼痛有改善的患者。在你处理髋骨关节炎合并腰痛的患者时，可以考虑向其推荐该计划。
items.titleZh: 针对髋骨关节炎症状的监督下患者教育和运动疗法能否改善腰痛？一项 5014 名患者的纵向队列研究
items.summaryZh: 在 5014 名髋骨关节炎患者中，61% 报告伴有腰痛。参与 GLA:D® 计划与腰痛强度在 3 个月时降低 19%、12 个月时降低 21% 显著相关，尤其在髋骨关节炎治疗响应者中效果更明显。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large cohort study suggests that the GLA:D® program is also effective for low back pain in hip OA patients, especially those with improved hip pain. Consider recommending this program to patients with hip OA and comorbid low back pain.
items.limitation: 观察性研究，存在混杂因素，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As an observational study, confounding factors exist, causality cannot be established, and selection bias may be present.

items.title: Preoperative factors associated with quadriceps strength 1 year after total knee arthroplasty: a prospective longitudinal study.
items.summary: In 39 older adults with uncomplicated TKA recovery, preoperative normalized quadriceps strength (B = 0.72) and limb symmetry index (B = -0.17) were significantly associated with quadriceps strength 1 year post-TKA.
items.curatedReason: 这项小型研究提示，术前股四头肌力量和肢体对称性可能是 TKA 术后 1 年股四头肌力量恢复的预测因素。但这只是初步探索性发现，在临床上用于评估和制定康复计划时要谨慎。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术后 1 年股四头肌力量的术前相关因素：一项前瞻性纵向研究
items.summaryZh: 在一项针对 39 名全膝关节置换术后恢复顺利的老年患者的研究中，术前标准化股四头肌力量（B = 0.72）和肢体对称指数（B = -0.17）与术后 1 年股四头肌力量显著相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small study suggests that preoperative quadriceps strength and limb symmetry might predict quadriceps strength recovery 1 year after TKA. However, these are preliminary exploratory findings, so exercise caution when using them clinically for assessment and rehabilitation planning.
items.limitation: 样本量小（n=39），仅限于恢复顺利的老年患者，结果应被视为探索性发现。
items.limitationEn: The small sample size (n=39) and focus on older adults with uncomplicated recovery mean the findings should be considered exploratory.
